# Draft:Luma3DS (custom firmware)

= Luma3DS (custom firmware) =
Luma3DS is a type of Custom firmware or also known as "CFW" that is used for the Nintendo 3DS console. Most people use Luma3DS to take full advantage of their console, or to install Homebrew applications. Luma3DS can be installed with software such as boot9strap. One of the essential parts of installing Custom firmware is having Luma3DS and boot9strapinstalled to install other Homebrew applications.
